items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: We had Charlie Cadela, Charlie Cadela, Harry Shields, Sharky, Joe Caparro... Joe Caparro was playing guitar.

ctx.x: Fifty years ago did they have a lot of solos? They start out an ensemble and everybody plays the same.

For, listen, for is drum solos. I'm going to put it on a drum. That only came a few years back as drum solos. Then a drum player never did play a drum solo in my years. All he done was play drums and give that band the tempo. When that band hit one, two, that leader hit one, two, three, four, there he was. If it wasn't with the sticks, it was the brushes, but mostly the brushes. You understand?
